sentence: Please put the book in the bag before we leave.
synonym: place the book in the bag
synonymNote: place表示放置，与put含义相同，可以互换

distractors.word: throw the book in the bag
distractors.note: throw表示用力扔，动作太粗猛，不合适

distractors.word: take the book in the bag
distractors.note: take表示拿走，方向相反，意思不同

distractors.word: leave the book in the bag
distractors.note: leave表示留下，是不同的动作含义
